title: 第一卷 第15章 遗愿第一卷 第16章 求助
lines: 林风眠匆匆来到后山，漫山遍野找着夏云溪。
他找了许久，才在一棵桃花树下，看到了那道熟悉的身影。
夏云溪此刻正跪在一个土坟前，徒手给土坟添土。
她一想到那干尸狰狞得看不出原样的模样，顿时悲从中来。
“师兄，师姐们说这样死去，是不会痛苦的……”
就在这时候，一道平静的声音从身后传来。
“假的，你看他们那表情，像是不痛苦吗？”
夏云溪顿时呆住了，难以置信地回头。
却见林风眠站在不远处，月色照映下，脸色有些发白。
林风眠嗯了一声，笑道：“怎么，认不出我来了吗？”
夏云溪不敢看他，害怕道：“师兄，你还有什么遗愿未了吗？”
林风眠嘴角微抽，这丫头是把自己当成鬼了？
看着她那跟鹌鹑一样的模样，他忍不住想逗一下她。
“是啊，我放心不下你，而且路上很寂寞啊！”
夏云溪虽然瑟瑟发抖，却还是鼓起勇气抬起头看着他。
“那师兄你带我一起走吧！”
林风眠听到这话，不由愣住了。
“你真要跟我一起走？”
夏云溪嗯了一声，凄然一笑道：“反正我也没什么牵挂了，你带我走吧！”
林风眠看着她这般模样，心中一软，摸了摸她的头，苦笑道：“你这傻丫头！”
夏云溪想到他一直以来的温柔，顿时战胜了恐惧，扑过去抱住他，泪如雨下。
“师兄，我舍不得你，我不想待在玉仙宗，我不想当妖女，你带我一起走吧！”
林风眠擦了擦她的泪水，笑道：“我带不了你走啊。”
“为什么？”
“因为我也还困在这里。”
夏云溪愣住了，这才意识到自己抱着的人是有温度的！
她又哭又笑道：“师兄，你没死？”
林风眠点了点头，笑道：“我哪有这么容易死？”
夏云溪激动地看着林风眠，动情道：“师兄！”
看着怀中的美人，林风眠不由感觉一阵燥热。
“云溪！”
他感觉一股热流涌上，忍不住对着那娇艳如花瓣的红唇吻了上去。
夏云溪嘤咛一声，瞪大了美目，娇躯一僵，而后又缓缓放松下来，闭上了眼睛。
content_en:
Lin Fengmian hurried to the back mountain and looked for Xia Yunxi all over the mountains and plains.
After searching for a long time, he saw the familiar figure under a peach blossom tree.
Xia Yunxi was kneeling in front of an earthen grave, adding soil to the earthen tomb with his bare hands.
When she thought that the mummy was so hideous that it was impossible to see its original appearance, she suddenly felt sad.
"Senior brother, senior sisters said that it will not be painful to die like this..."
At this moment, a calm voice came from behind.
"It's fake. Look at their expressions, don't they look like they're not in pain?"
Xia Yunxi was stunned for a moment and turned around in disbelief.
But he saw Lin Fengmian standing not far away, his face a little pale under the moonlight.
"Senior...senior brother?!"
Lin Fengmian hummed and said with a smile: "Why, don't you recognize me?"
Xia Yunxi didn't dare to look at him and said in fear: "Senior brother, do you have any last wishes?"
Lin Fengmian's mouth twitched slightly, did this girl think she was a ghost?
Seeing her quail-like appearance, he couldn't help but want to tease her.
"Yeah, I can't worry about you, and it's very lonely on the road!"
Although Xia Yunxi was trembling, she still mustered up the courage to raise her head and look at him.
"Then senior brother, please take me with you!"
Lin Fengmian was stunned when he heard this.
"Do you really want to come with me?"
Xia Yunxi hummed, smiled sadly and said, "I don't have anything to worry about anyway, just take me away!"
Seeing her like this, Lin Fengmian's heart softened, he touched her head and said with a bitter smile: "You silly girl!"
Xia Yunxi thought of how gentle he had always been, and immediately overcame her fear, rushed over to hug him, and burst into tears.
"Senior brother, I can't bear to leave you. I don't want to stay in the Jade Immortal Sect, and I don't want to be a witch. Please take me with you!"
Lin Fengmian wiped her tears and said with a smile, "I can't take you away."
"Why?"
"Because I'm still stuck here too."
Xia Yunxi was stunned, and then realized that the person he was holding had warmth!
She cried and laughed: "Brother, are you not dead?"
Lin Fengmian nodded and said with a smile: "How could I die so easily?"
Xia Yunxi looked at Lin Fengmian excitedly and said emotionally: "Senior brother!"
Looking at the beauty in his arms, Lin Fengmian couldn't help but feel hot.
"Yunxi!"
He felt a surge of heat and couldn't help but kiss those delicate red lips like petals.
Xia Yunxi groaned, her beautiful eyes widened, her delicate body stiffened, and then she slowly relaxed and closed her eyes.
